purpose: A person card's Interests: each with its note, who added it and who sees it.
namedChanges: The imports are the units': `HeldVisibilitySwitch` and `AddedByLine` from `added-by`, `CardGroup` from `card-group`, `useCardMode` from `card-mode`, `skillReferentUri` and `ThinSkill` from `contact-rows`, `useHeldNotes` from `held-notes`, `RemoveControl` from `remove-control`, `SkillDepthNote` and `SkillPickerSheet` from `skill-picker-sheet`, `termLabelOfIri` from `term-slots`.

THE NAME RULE (Kai, 2026-10-31): an interest is shown by its name, never by its address or the last part of it. The private component `TermName` (source lines 33-47: the label or `iri.slice(iri.lastIndexOf("/") + 1)`) is the hook `useTermNames(iris, picked)` (new): the picked name, else the term's label, else "…" while it is read, else `referentNameOf(iri)` of `term-name-text`, else `termNameWord("interest")`. `nameOf(iri)` replaces `picked[iri] ?? <last part of the address>` at the four places that named the interest (the (−) label, the edit button's label, the note's name, the visibility switch's noun) and `<TermName/>` at the two places that drew it.

The line that drew the interest's address outside presentation (source line 133, `

{iri}

`) is removed.
